description_en: Retrieves the access layer diagnostic results
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-controller-detection --db-cluster-id amv-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeControllerDetection

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query all clusters in a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query supported regions and zones, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the logs. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC).

When you query logs, the end time must be later than the start time, and the maximum interval between the start time and the end time is 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
日志的结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。

查询日志时，结束时间需大于开始时间，且与开始时间最大间隔不超过30天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The language configuration. Valid values:
zh: Simplified Chinese (default).
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
zh：简体中文（默认语言）。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

DetectionItems.description_en: The list of detection items and results
DetectionItems.description_zh: 检测项及检测结果列表

Message.example: A CPU increase is detected on the access node.

Name.description_en: The name of the detection item

Status.description_en:
The status of the detection result. Valid values:

NORMAL
WARNING
CRITICAL
Status.description_zh:
检测结果状态。取值：

NORMAL
WARNING
CRITICAL

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
